title: Major Brett Devries Awarded Distinguished Flying Cross
description:
The Honorable Barbara Barrett, Secretary of the Air Force, presented the Distinguished Flying Cross to Major Brett DeVries from the 127th Wing.  DeVries is being recognized for safely landing an A-10 Thunderbolt II after a catastrophic aircraft malfunction caused the canopy to eject and crippled the landing gear. DeVries, a senior A-10 pilot assigned to the 107th Fighter Squadron here, has more than 2,000 flight hours to include 830 in combat. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Andrew Schumann)
